newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Futures Exchange to relaunch HIBOR futures.
newsitem.headline: HK Futures Exchange to relaunch HIBOR futures.

text.p: The Hong Kong Futures Exchange Ltd will relaunch trading in interest rate futures in September, senior exchange executives said on Thursday.
Trading in futures contracts on the Hong Kong inter-bank offered rate (HIBOR) will be relaunched on Friday, September 26, exchange chairman Frank Wong said

"I am announcing the date for the re-introduction of the HIBOR futures contract at this time so members and their clients have adequate time to make arrangements to participate in the market," Wong said.
The contract will be traded on the exchange's automated trading system exchange.
